registered_after: no-repeat audit plus opened-panel candidate-space coverage diagnostic
registered_before: feature-cache materialization, model initialization, training, local inference, or local scoring
hypothesis: dense top-8 TASKA boundary contacts provide a sufficiently covered translation roster; an edge-aware all-component graph Transformer can improve conditional shift retrieval and jointly anchor up to four components without a raw-seam veto

no_repeat_boundary.generic_component_set_absolute_head: not run because component_absolute_placer already combined native component pixels, board-set attention, purity and joint feasible absolute offsets and remained at chance
no_repeat_boundary.selected_supply_relation_roster: stopped before fit because it covered only 0.3604% of fit components and 0.6267% of fit dominant support
no_repeat_boundary.whole_layout_origin: not repeated; no standalone roll or frame head
no_repeat_boundary.component_relation_reranker: reused only as evidence that relation ranking can transfer; this model jointly contextualizes every component and scores TASKA dense-contact pose candidates rather than independent Socket relation queries
no_repeat_boundary.socket_permutation_flow: does not dissolve rigid components into tile-slot Hungarian logits

fit_panel: formal source16 x draw2 organizer-train confirmed six-arm archive
local_panel: held source16 x draw2 organizer-train confirmed six-arm archive
candidate_roster: four directional dense cost queries per member tile; external-component top8 contacts imply feasible rigid shifts; zero shift retained
node_evidence: dirty-only tile colour, boundary and gradient descriptors pooled per real component plus current geometry
graph_evidence: all directed component-pair contact aggregates; two sparse relation-message plus global self-attention layers
candidate_evidence: rank, normalized cost, support, target diversity, direction and destination geometry
augmentations: component-order permutation every update, Gaussian standardized-feature jitter, 15% pair-feature dropout, 10% candidate-feature dropout, paired independent corruption draws
decoder: place up to four learned anchors jointly, preserve remaining baseline components when collision-free, repack by minimum baseline displacement, Hungarian-fill deferred tiles
capacity_gate: conditional shift R@1 at least 0.80 on one fit board after 80 steps
local_retrieval_gate: support-weighted R@1 gain at least +0.02 and R@5 loss no worse than -0.01 versus identical raw candidate roster
local_layout_gate: exact delta strictly positive and satisfied-pair delta at least -1 per board
heavy_run_policy: prepare server-scale continuation only if every capacity, retrieval and layout gate passes; otherwise stop without a longer run
